forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {償|つぐな}っていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to compensate, to make up for, to pay for
definitions.explanation: To provide restitution or compensation for damage, loss, or harm caused.

definitions.gloss: to atone for, to make amends
definitions.explanation: To take action to make up for a wrong or sin one has committed.

examples.japanese: ⟦{損害|そんがい}→損害：02615_songai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{償|つぐな}う。
⟦{保険|ほけん}→保険：01509_hoken⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{被害|ひがい}→被害：02572_higai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{償|つぐな}うこと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: I was able to compensate for the damage through insurance.

examples.japanese: ⟦お{金|かね}→お金：00611_okane⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{償|つぐな}いきれない⟦{損失|そんしつ}→損失：04875_sonshitsu⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There are losses that cannot be fully compensated with money.

examples.japanese: ⟦{過去|かこ}→過去：00152_kako⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{過|あやま}ち→過ち：14376_ayamachi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{償|つぐな}う⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ボランティア→ボランティア：04834_borantia⟧⟦{活動|かつどう}→活動：00201_katsudou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{続|つづ}け→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧て⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: To atone for past mistakes, he continues volunteer work.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{罪|つみ}→罪：03532_tsumi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{一生|いっしょう}→一生：01728_isshou⟧⟦かけて→かける：00854_kakeru⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{償|つぐな}えないだろう。
examples.english: This sin probably can't be atoned for even in a lifetime.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: ⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧ (transitive). Pattern: X⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{償|つぐな}う.

USAGE:
Sense 1 is used in legal and financial contexts for compensation and restitution. Sense 2 is used in moral and personal contexts for atonement and making amends.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{損害|そんがい}→損害：02615_songai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{償|つぐな}う: to compensate for damage
- ⟦{罪|つみ}→罪：03532_tsumi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{償|つぐな}う: to atone for one's sins
- ⟦{過|あやま}ち→過ち：14376_ayamachi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{償|つぐな}う: to make amends for mistakes
- ⟦{被害|ひがい}→被害：02572_higai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{償|つぐな}う: to compensate for harm

RELATED WORDS:
⟦{賠償|ばいしょう}→賠償：07641_baishou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ is the more formal/legal term for "to compensate" and is standard in legal documents. {償|つぐな}う has a broader, more personal tone.
